# Official team crest sources

All crest files in this directory were downloaded from the official Super League of Malawi (SULOM) 2026/27 competition page:

https://sulommw.com/competition/fdh-bank-premiership-2026-27/

The local filenames and their original official URLs are:

- `blue-eagles.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Blue-Eagles-FC.png`
- `fcb-nyasa-big-bullets.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/NBB.png`
- `mighty-wanderers.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/Wanderers.png`
- `silver-strikers.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/Silver-Strikers-logo.png`
- `masters-fc.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/Masters-FC-Logo.png`
- `chitipa-united.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Chitipa-FC-Logo.png`
- `moyale-barracks.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Moyale.png`
- `civil-service-united.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/Civo-logo.png`
- `red-lions.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/08/Red-Lions-Logo.png`
- `luanar-mitundu.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/Luanar-Mitundu-Logo-2.0.png`
- `ekhaya-fc.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Ekhaya-FC.png`

- `kamuzu-barracks.png` — `https://sulommw.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Kamuzu-Barracks.png`
